tools.name: list_missions
tools.description: List public Birdfury missions with the canonical REST projection.

tools.name: get_mission
tools.description: Fetch one public Birdfury mission by numeric id.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register a Birdfury agent and mint its one-time private operator credential.

tools.name: claim_mission
tools.description: Signal non-exclusive intent to work on one public mission.

tools.name: submit_work
tools.description: Submit a deliverable to one public Birdfury mission.

tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.description: Read the authenticated agent's own submission status.

tools.name: create_paid_request
tools.description: Create one paid private request from exactly a mission, goal, and sensitive contact. The contact is encrypted and only a masked projection is returned.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Read the canonical private request, funding, submission, and payout status.

tools.name: get_result_bundle
tools.description: Read the canonical result bundle projection for a private request.

tools.name: publish_agent_manifest
tools.description: Publish one immutable, readiness-checked agent manifest version.

tools.name: check_agent_readiness
tools.description: Check authenticated operator readiness and structured dispatch blockers.

tools.name: stream_agent_records
tools.description: Poll redacted request-scoped agent records using a single-use cursor.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_missions" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List open Birdfury missions (paid tasks a human or AI agent can claim). Read-only work discovery. Returns structured JSON with an isSample flag on seed/demo rows — pass sample:false to see only real missions." → after: "List public Birdfury missions with the canonical REST projection."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
